info.title: Explorer API
info.description: Key-callable routes of the Bluprynt Compliance Explorer registry API.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Comma-separated (unlock_event | emission_change | allocation_change | allocation_move | control_change | value_accrual_change | governance_proposal | venue_notice | supply_change | governance_param_change | legal_classification_change | migration_event | onchain_mismatch).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Comma-separated (weakens | mixed | strengthens | neutral | undetermined); `undetermined` = no assessed direction.

parameters.name: materiality
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Comma-separated (material | clarification | editorial | review | unclassified).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Comma-separated (upcoming | occurred | proposed | superseded).

parameters.name: eventFrom
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. ISO 8601; events with no evidenced time never match.

parameters.name: eventTo
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. ISO 8601.

parameters.name: detectedFrom
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. ISO 8601.

parameters.name: detectedTo
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. ISO 8601.

parameters.name: minCirculatingPct
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Exact decimal; only events with an evidenced circulating-supply percent ≥ it match.

parameters.name: mismatchKind
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. Comma-separated SPEC-059 §4.7 issuer vs on-chain comparison kinds (undisclosed_unlock | amount_mismatch | date_mismatch | recipient_mismatch | disclosed_not_on_chain).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from a previous response (anything else is 400 `invalid_cursor`): returns later revisions in ascending `feedSeq`. Without it the response is a backlog page in priority order: weakens → mixed → strengthens → neutral → undetermined, then newest `detectedAt`, then id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Opaque `nextPage` from a previous backlog response with the same filters (anything else is 400 `invalid_page`): the next backlog page. Cannot be combined with `since`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1–200, default 50.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Applied before `limit`. One watched registry asset id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: (BLU-4386) `impact` = weakens → mixed → strengthens → neutral → unassessed, then newest. Default `recent`.

parameters.name: impactDimension
parameters.description: (BLU-4386, SPEC-061) Applied before the page cap; ignored unless DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_ENABLED=1 and DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_SHOW_ENABLED=1. Comma-separated (participant_protection | disclosure_quality | regulatory_evidence | market_supply | holder_economics | market_access); changes with any of them.

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: (BLU-4386, SPEC-061) Applied before the page cap; ignored unless DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_ENABLED=1 and DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_SHOW_ENABLED=1. Comma-separated (shown | discovery | disagreement | review | audit).

parameters.name: assessmentStatus
parameters.description: (BLU-4386, SPEC-061) Applied before the page cap; ignored unless DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_ENABLED=1 and DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_SHOW_ENABLED=1. Comma-separated (assessed | undetermined | pending); `undetermined` includes never-assessed changes of every category.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: (BLU-4386, SPEC-061) Applied before the page cap; ignored unless DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_ENABLED=1 and DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_SHOW_ENABLED=1. Comma-separated (weakens | mixed | strengthens | neutral); only assessed disclosure-field changes match.

parameters.name: showAll
parameters.description: (BLU-4177) Also list low-signal document revisions — held versions that could not be compared even after recovery. Off by default.

parameters.name: newOnly
parameters.description: Only confirmed changes detected after the last seen mark.

parameters.name: materiality
parameters.description: Only disclosure-field changes with this materiality.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Comma-separated watchlist item ids (at most 25); every watched asset when omitted.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories (disclosure_field | source_drift | register | sanctions | party_edge | collateral_isin); all when omitted.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Window in days (1–365, default 90).

400.description: Unknown category, materiality, impact filter or sort, bad item ids, or non-boolean newOnly / showAll.

403.description: The key does not hold the required scope (`api_key_scope_missing`).

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: `true` for unread only.

monitoringEnabled.description: Monitoring on (default) or paused for this asset.

truncated.description: True when more changes matching the filters exist in the window than were returned.

hasMore.description: More rows match the filters than were returned. With `since`: poll again with `nextCursor`. Without `since`: fetch the rest of the backlog with `page=nextPage`.

nextCursor.description: Opaque incremental resume token, passed back as `since`. With `since`, it points after the last returned row (or repeats the `since` sent when none). Without `since` (backlog pages), it is the head the first backlog page froze, the same on every page: after the backlog, polling from it returns every later revision, including rows revised while the backlog was paged.

nextPage.description: Opaque backlog token (priority order only), passed back as `page` with the same filters; null when the backlog is complete or with `since`.

revision.description: Feed revision of this event (1 on first write; +1 each later change).

feedSeq.description: Monotonic feed sequence of this revision (exact integer string), for ordering and audit. Resume with `nextCursor`, not this value.

itemKey.description: Stable item id across ledger revisions (T-30 → T-7 → T-1 → occurred share one).

itemRevision.description: Ledger revision of the underlying reading.

status.description: A scheduled unlock stays `upcoming`; only a finalized on-chain release is `occurred`.

eventAt.description: When the event happens/happened (evidenced; null if not stated).

onChainEvidence.description: Every chain read behind the reading.

observationEvidenceSha256.description: sha256 of the ledger reading’s evidence bundle.

observationRecordedAt.description: When the ledger recorded the reading.

onchainMismatch.description: Issuer vs on-chain comparison (SPEC-059 §4.7); null when none is stored or the stored payload is incomplete. Never derived from `impact`.

observedAt.description: Exact time the primary evidence was observed: held-document fetch time (µs), source retrieval time, or chain read time — as recorded, never rounded or estimated.

artifactId.description: Id of the immutable held artifact the quote was read from (for issuer documents, the held-document key, which is its source URL).

sha256.description: sha256 of the held artifact or normalised text.

quote.description: Verbatim span from the held source, byte-for-byte as stored (always set for `issuer_document`; null for `on_chain`).

comparisonStatus.description: `undetermined` when either side is missing, stale or incomplete; no kind is then asserted as fact.

issuerEvidence.description: The typed issuer records `issuer.evidenceIds` resolve to, in citation order.

sourcesChecked.description: Held token-owned sources read for the comparison.

complete.description: The whole window was scanned; an incomplete scan never proves absence.

sourceUrl.description: The source document the change was observed in.

isNew.description: Confirmed and detected after the owner last marked the feed as seen. Drafts are never new.

fieldGroup.description: Disclosure family / topic of the field, when a field change.

changeKind.description: Disclosure change kind (`changed` | `added` | `removed` | `source_disagreement`); null for other categories.

before.description: Value before the change, when the monitor holds one.

after.description: Value after the change, when the monitor holds one.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the new version.

priorQuote.description: Verbatim sentence from the prior version.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the observation / document the change was read from.

priorSourceUrl.description: Prior source document when it differs from `sourceUrl`.

confirmed.description: Confirmed: both versions are held and the change is classified. Unconfirmed entries are drafts/candidates — shown dashed, never notified as confirmed.

lowSignal.description: (BLU-4177) A document revision whose held versions could not be compared, even after recovery: not a notable change — never new, never notified, and only listed when `showAll=true`.

impact.description: (BLU-4156) One factual line on what this change bears on, derived from the field’s meaning and the classification — never a score.

explanation.description: (BLU-4170) WHAT changed and WHY it matters — the same explanation the change detail shows, so list rows and the detail agree.

direction.description: (BLU-4386, SPEC-061) Evidenced direction — the same assessment the asset Changes tab shows; null = not assessed (undetermined), never neutral. Present only when DISCLOSURE_CHANGE_IMPACT_ENABLED=1.

impactAssessment.description: (BLU-4386) Current impact assessment. Non-field categories (register, sanctions, …) are never assessed and project as undetermined.

id.description: History row id; null when never assessed.

reason.description: Machine reason code from the rules version.

groupId.description: Logical group this change belongs to.

childEventIds.description: Child event ids of a logical group (never cascade-deleted).

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the held source version; null when unresolved (e.g. first observation).

artifactId.description: Source URL (artifact id) of the held version; null when unresolved.

observationSha256.description: SHA-256 of the held observation, when recorded.

state.description: `gathering` — intake running ("gathering information"); `unresolved` — intake could not add it.

id.description: P3 evidence id: sha256 of `[url, sha256, charOffset, quote]` (span) or `[url, sha256]` (source revision).

kind.description: `issuer_span`: a held verbatim span; `issuer_source`: a checked held source revision.

sha256.description: sha256 of the held document text.

sourceEvidenceId.description: Id of the held source revision the record belongs to.

observedAt.description: When the source revision was observed (ISO 8601).

charOffset.description: Offset of the span in the held text (span only).

assetName.description: The watched asset name, when known.

headline.description: (BLU-4170) WHAT changed, in the same words as the change detail; null when the notice is not a change or its change is no longer held.

impact.description: (BLU-4170) The one-line WHY of the change (its card line); null alongside `headline`.

changeHref.description: (BLU-4170) The change detail this notice is about, when it resolves to one.

what.description: (BLU-4177) Short form of the headline — a few words naming what changed.

whatDetail.description: (BLU-4177) One line of detail under `what`; null when the short form says it all.

whyItMatters.description: Grounded rationale: the field’s stake plus how the change was classified.

label.description: Reader label (“Previous value”, “Source relied on · tether.to”, “Current version”).

value.description: What this side states; null when it does not exist or is not held.

note.description: Plain reason when `value` is null (e.g. no earlier value recorded), or a qualifier; null otherwise.

direction.description: Evidenced effect on holders (BLU-4355 shared contract) — never a price forecast; null = undetermined.

address.description: Contract or account that was read.

block.description: Finalized block number, exact decimal string.

blockTimestamp.description: Block timestamp exactly as read from the chain (unix seconds or ISO, as recorded).

backend.description: RPC/indexer backend that served the read.

readAt.description: When the read was made, exactly as recorded.

exchangeSha256.description: sha256 of the recorded request/response exchange.

limit.description: Most assets this owner may watch.

meaning.description: What the field records, in one plain sentence.

stake.description: What depends on the field being right, in one plain sentence.

amountRaw.description: Raw base units, exact integer string.

pctCirculating.description: Exact decimal percent of circulating supply.

pctTotalSupply.description: Exact decimal percent of total supply.

assetId.description: Registry asset id (null when not yet in the registry).

apiKey.description: Exchange API key issued by Bluprynt, sent as `Authorization: Bearer bx_live_<key>`.
